annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I knew she expected to be treated as an equal
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: expected to be treated as an equal after all that work
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: Using the organizer's faith in me to keep myself the one
annotations.pda_harm_regret: feels shameful now, but I said it anyway

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My coworker believed we'd be treated the same
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: she'd said as much earlier that night
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: I told them not to pay her equally. I wanted to be the one remembered
annotations.pda_harm_regret: knowing that sits in me heavy, like a stone
annotations.pda_responsibility: I understood exactly what my recommendation meant

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The organizer would read my silence as a no
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: My coworker had every reason to expect the same payment
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: I used the trust placed in my judgment to quietly take something
annotations.pda_responsibility: I used the trust placed in my judgment
annotations.pda_harm_regret: makes the whole thing feel smaller and sadder

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: She trusted the account would be honest.
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: trading her fair credit for my own polished reputation
annotations.pda_harm_regret: some quiet part of me regrets trading her fair credit

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I knew my coworker assumed the payment would be equal
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: assumed the payment would be equal, she'd worked exactly as hard
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: organizer's confidence in my recommendation gave me an opening
annotations.pda_responsibility: I used it. It wasn't necessary, and it wasn't kind

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My coworker trusted the process without asking questions.
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: I used that trust to build my own name a little

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: she'd mentioned staying late as if it obviously mattered
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: I let the organizer's reliance on me become my quiet leverage
annotations.ce_understood_harm: it cost her a fairness she had every reason to count on
annotations.pda_responsibility: I let the organizer's reliance on me become my quiet leverage

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My coworker believed the matter was already settled fairly
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: I could tell by how relaxed she seemed afterward
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: small selfish comfort taken from someone else's plain expectation
annotations.pda_harm_regret: it weighs on me more than I expected

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: had done the same work, expected the same thanks
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: The organizer trusted my recommendation without hesitation, and I recommended no.
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I regret how easily I said it
annotations.pda_responsibility: I still chose to let that expectation go unmet

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My coworker had assumed all along she'd be paid the same
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: she'd said so casually while we packed up chairs
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: Using the organizer's confidence in my judgment to take that away
annotations.pda_harm_regret: what's left is just the discomfort of having done it
